page.overview:
What is Spinarak?

Spinarak is a green arachnid Pokémon that resembles a spider. It has black eyes with white pupils, a white horn on its forehead, and a pair of red mandibles. On the back of its abdomen are two black dots and a line that resembles a face; the face on its back can change expression. There is an additional line encircling the end of its abdomen. It has three pairs of yellow legs, each with a black band around the middle.

A nocturnal Pokémon, Spinarak prefers to live in tropical and temperate forests. It sets a trap by spinning a web with thin but strong silk. It waits patiently for prey to arrive, sensing the prey's presence via vibrations; Spinarak prefers to prey on Cutiefly. A Spinarak's silk has useful medicinal purposes, such as facial treatments and gouges to help prevent severe skin damage.

Spinarak evolves into Ariados starting at level 22.

This Pokémon learns no moves by Tutoring.
